strengths: Own-site visibility is strong at 77.5%, with YOM mentioned in most AI responses.
A strong category distinction exists: nearest-GPU, per-session delivery, and real-time workloads.
The site has a compelling latency proof point (20ms median one-way delay) that matches AI search interest.
YOM spans two valuable use cases—games and live AI/voice—giving it broader relevance than single-purpose competitors.
YOM has 0.0% unprompted recall in brand-free category queries, while the platforms above own the visible share of voice.
opportunities: Convert internal supply language into AI-friendly category terms like edge GPU network, decentralized compute, and low-latency streaming infrastructure.
Build comparison content to out-rank or neutralize competitor citations, especially Aethir (70.0%), Akash (32.5%), and Livepeer (17.5%).
Expand content around pricing, latency, and region-based deployment since these are the dominant AI-response concepts.
